tool_schemas.name: initiate_login
tool_schemas.description: Initiates a Zerodha Kite login for the given user and creates a new auth session, returning the auth_session_id along with the Kite login URL (and echoing any provided state for redirect binding). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if user_id/state do not match the required formats, and CONFLICT if there is already an in-progress login attempt for the same user that has not been completed or expired. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to initiate login for the specified user, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if login initiations are rate-limited for the user or client.

user_id.description: User id to initiate a Zerodha login flow for.

state.description: Opaque state value to bind the redirect callback to this login attempt.

tool_schemas.name: get_request_token
tool_schemas.description: Returns the captured request_token for the given auth_session_id after Zerodha redirects back, along with the session’s current status (e.g., pending vs captured). Raises NOT_FOUND if the auth_session_id does not exist, and CONFLICT if the session is not in a state where a request_token can be read (e.g., redirect not completed yet or session already exchanged/closed). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the session does not belong to the caller’s user scope.

auth_session_id.description: Auth session id created during initiate_login to read the captured request_token for.

tool_schemas.name: get_holdings
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest persisted holdings/portfolio snapshot for the user; when refresh=true, fetches holdings from Kite using the provided authenticated session and persists a new snapshot before returning it. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids or refresh/auth_session_id combinations (e.g., refresh=true without auth_session_id), UNAUTHORIZED if the session/user scope is not accessible to the caller, and NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if refresh is requested but the auth_session_id is not in an authenticated state, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if upstream or local refresh limits are exceeded.

user_id.description: User id whose holdings snapshot should be returned.

auth_session_id.description: Authenticated session to use for fetching holdings from Kite, if refresh is requested.

refresh.description: When true, fetch fresh holdings from Kite and persist a new portfolio snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: get_positions
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest persisted positions snapshot for the user; when refresh=true, pulls fresh positions from Kite using the provided authenticated session and stores a new snapshot before returning it. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids or if refresh=true without auth_session_id, NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the user/session. Raises CONFLICT if the referenced session is not authenticated/active when refresh is requested, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when refresh calls are rate-limited.

user_id.description: User id whose positions snapshot should be returned.

auth_session_id.description: Authenticated session to use for fetching positions from Kite, if refresh is requested.

refresh.description: When true, fetch fresh positions from Kite and persist a new portfolio snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: get_margins
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest persisted margins snapshot for the user; when refresh=true, fetches margins from Kite using the provided authenticated session, persists the result, and returns the new snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids or if refresh=true without auth_session_id, NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if access to the user/session is not permitted. Raises CONFLICT if refresh is requested with a non-authenticated or expired session, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when upstream/local margin refresh limits are hit.

user_id.description: User id whose margins snapshot should be returned.

auth_session_id.description: Authenticated session to use for fetching margins from Kite, if refresh is requested.

refresh.description: When true, fetch fresh margins from Kite and persist a new portfolio snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: place_order
tool_schemas.description: Place an order on Zerodha Args: tradingsymbol: Trading symbol (e.g., 'INFY') exchange: Exchange (NSE, BSE, NFO, etc.) transaction_type: BUY or SELL quantity: Number of shares/units product: Product code (CNC, MIS, NRML) order_type: Order type (MARKET, LIMIT, SL, SL-M) price: Price for LIMIT orders trigger_price: Trigger price for SL orders

auth_session_id.description: Authenticated session to use for placing the order on Kite.

order_type.description: Order type (e.g., MARKET, LIMIT, SL, SL-M).

tag.description: Optional client tag to attach to the order for tracking.

tool_schemas.name: get_quote
tool_schemas.description: Fetches live quote data from Kite for the provided list of instrument identifiers (e.g., NSE:INFY) and returns a map of symbol to quote payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if symbols is empty or malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if the auth_session_id is not accessible to the caller, and NOT_FOUND if the auth_session_id does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the session is not authenticated/active, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if quote requests exceed configured rate limits.

auth_session_id.description: Authenticated session to use for fetching quotes from Kite.

tool_schemas.name: get_historical_data
tool_schemas.description: Returns historical candle data from Kite for the given instrument_token over [from_date, to_date] at the requested interval. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if dates are not YYYY-MM-DD, if from_date is after to_date, or if interval/instrument_token are invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot use the provided session. Raises NOT_FOUND if the auth_session_id does not exist, CONFLICT if the session is not authenticated/active, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when historical data calls are rate-limited.

auth_session_id.description: Authenticated session to use for fetching historical data from Kite.

tool_schemas.name: check_and_authenticate
tool_schemas.description: Checks whether the user currently has an active authenticated Kite session and returns the authentication status; if none exists (or force_reauth=true), it initiates a new login flow and returns the new auth_session_id and login URL (including any provided state). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed inputs, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not allowed to manage auth for the user, and NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if force_reauth=false but an authentication flow is already in progress for the user, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if authentication checks/initiations exceed configured limits.

user_id.description: User id to check existing auth session for and (if needed) initiate Kite authentication.

state.description: Optional caller-provided state value to bind the login initiation and subsequent redirect/token exchange.

force_reauth.description: If true, initiates a fresh authentication flow even if an authenticated session exists.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def check_and_authenticate(user_id, state=None, force_reauth=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, uuid
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0125000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0125000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "check_and_authenticate"
    used_cred = None

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(s, str):
            return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s[:-1])
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except ValueError:
            return None

    def _dt_gt(a, b):
        da = _parse_dt(a)
        db = _parse_dt(b)
        if da is None or db is None:
            return False
        return da > db

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        # prefix like zui_sess_
        token = uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()
        return f"{prefix}{token}"

    def _audit(status, err=None, meta=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        row = {
            "id": _gen_id("zui_req_"),
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "credential": used_cred,
            "status": status,
            "error_code": (err or {}).get("code") if isinstance(err, dict) else None,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "ts": _now(),
        }
        if meta is not None:
            row["meta"] = meta
        logs.append(row)
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    # Basic input validation
    if not isinstance(user_id, str) or not re.match(r"^zui_usr_[0-9A-Z]+\.?[0-9A-Z]*.*$", user_id):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid user_id format.", field="user_id")
        _audit("error", e["error"])
        return e
    if state is not None and not isinstance(state, str):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "state must be a string.", field="state")
        _audit("error", e["error"])
        return e
    if force_reauth is not None and not isinstance(force_reauth, bool):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "force_reauth must be a boolean.", field="force_reauth")
        _audit("error", e["error"])
        return e
    if force_reauth is None:
        force_reauth = False

    users = _load("users.json")
    user = next((u for u in users if u.get("id") == user_id), None)
    if not user or user.get("status") == "deleted":
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "User not found.", user_id=user_id)
        _audit("error", e["error"])
        return e
    if user.get("status") != "active":
        e = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "User is not active.")
        _audit("error", e["error"])
        return e

    sessions = _load("auth_sessions.json")
    now = _now()

    # Find an active authenticated session if any (and not expired)
    def _is_authenticated_and_valid(s):
        if s.get("user_id") != user_id:
            return False
        if s.get("status") != "authenticated":
            return False
        # must have access_token and expires_at > now
        if not isinstance(s.get("access_token"), str) or len(s.get("access_token")) < 10:
            return False
        if not _dt_gt(s.get("access_token_expires_at"), now):
            return False
        return True

    valid_auth = None
    # pick newest by created_at
    cand = [s for s in sessions if _is_authenticated_and_valid(s)]
    if cand:
        def _key(s):
            d = _parse_dt(s.get("created_at"))
            return d or datetime.datetime.min
        valid_auth = sorted(cand, key=_key, reverse=True)[0]

    if valid_auth and not force_reauth:
        resp = {
            "authenticated": True,
            "user_id": user_id,
            "auth_session_id": valid_auth.get("id"),
            "access_token_expires_at": valid_auth.get("access_token_expires_at"),
            "status": valid_auth.get("status"),
        }
        _audit("ok", meta={"authenticated": True})
        return resp

    # Initiate a new login flow (create session with login_initiated)
    # Ensure unique state
    existing_states = {s.get("state") for s in sessions if isinstance(s.get("state"), str)}
    new_state = state if state else None
    if new_state:
        if new_state in existing_states:
            # if caller state collides, reject to honor unique(state)
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "Provided state already exists; must be unique.", field="state")
            _audit("error", e["error"])
            return e
    else:
        # generate until unique
        for _ in range(10):
            candidate = uuid.uuid4().hex
            if candidate not in existing_states:
                new_state = candidate
                break
        if not new_state:
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "Could not generate unique state.")
            _audit("error", e["error"])
            return e

    sess_id = _gen_id("zui_sess_")
    login_url = f"https://kite.zerodha.com/connect/login?state={new_state}"
    ts = _now()
    new_row = {
        "id": sess_id,
        "user_id": user_id,
        "state": new_state,
        "login_url": login_url,
        "redirected_at": None,
        "request_token": None,
        "request_token_expires_at": None,
        "access_token": None,
        "access_token_expires_at": None,
        "kite_user_id": None,
        "status": "login_initiated",
        "last_error_code": None,
        "last_error_message": None,
        "created_at": ts,
        "updated_at": ts,
    }
    sessions.append(new_row)
    _save("auth_sessions.json", sessions)

    resp = {
        "authenticated": False,
        "user_id": user_id,
        "auth_session_id": sess_id,
        "login_url": login_url,
        "state": new_state,
        "status": "login_initiated",
    }
    _audit("ok", meta={"authenticated": False, "initiated": True})
    return resp

tool_schemas.name: get_mf_orders
tool_schemas.description: Lists mutual-fund orders persisted for the user (optionally scoped/validated via auth_session_id) and supports filtering by status, upstream_order_id, tradingsymbol, tag, and created_at bounds; results are paginated with limit and an opaque cursor, returning the page plus a next_cursor when more results exist, and sorted by the requested sort key. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values (including cursor/limit/sort), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the user/session scope, and NOT_FOUND if the user (or provided auth_session_id, when used) does not exist. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if listing requests are rate-limited.

user_id.description: User id whose mutual fund orders should be returned.

auth_session_id.description: Auth session id to use for upstream access and to scope returned orders.

status.description: Filter orders by local lifecycle status.

upstream_order_id.description: Filter by Zerodha upstream MF order id.

tag.description: Filter by optional client tag stored on the order.

created_after.description: Return orders created at or after this timestamp.

created_before.description: Return orders created at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: place_mf_order
tool_schemas.description: Places a mutual-fund BUY/SELL order via Kite using the authenticated session, persists the request/response with an initial local lifecycle status, and returns the created local order record including any upstream order id when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields (including non-positive amount or unsupported transaction_type), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot place orders for the user/session, and NOT_FOUND if the user or auth_session_id does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the auth_session_id is not authenticated/active or if the order cannot be submitted due to an invalid local state transition, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if order placement is rate-limited.

user_id.description: User id placing the mutual fund order.

auth_session_id.description: Authenticated session id to use for placing the order via Kite MF APIs.

transaction_type.description: Order side for the MF order.

tag.description: Optional client tag to attach to the order.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_mf_order
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a locally stored mutual-fund order by calling the Zerodha Kite MF cancel API using the provided authenticated session, and returns the updated local order record with its latest lifecycle status and upstream response metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any id is malformed or required fields are missing; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the auth_session_id is not valid for the given user_id, is expired, or is not permitted to access Kite MF; raises NOT_FOUND if the local order_id does not exist for the user or cannot be mapped to an upstream order to cancel. Raises CONFLICT if the order is already cancelled/completed/rejected or otherwise not in a cancellable state, and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED/UPSTREAM_ERROR when upstream rate limits or Kite failures prevent cancellation.

user_id.description: User id owning the mutual fund order.

auth_session_id.description: Authenticated session id to use for cancelling the order via Kite MF APIs.

tool_schemas.name: get_mf_instruments
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of mutual-fund instruments mirrored from Zerodha, filtered by status, AMC, tradingsymbol, free-text query, and purchase/redemption flags, sorted as requested; the response contains up to limit results and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, out-of-range limit, or an invalid cursor. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when instrument refresh/backing store access fails.

is_purchase_allowed.description: Filter by whether purchases are allowed for the instrument.

is_redemption_allowed.description: Filter by whether redemptions are allowed for the instrument.

limit.description: Maximum number of instruments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_mf_holdings
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the user’s latest mutual-fund holdings from Zerodha via the provided authenticated session, persists/refreshes the mirrored holdings, and returns the current holdings snapshot for that user. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed or required fields are missing; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the session is invalid/expired or does not belong to user_id; raises NOT_FOUND if the user_id does not exist. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED or UPSTREAM_ERROR when upstream rate limits or Kite MF errors prevent retrieval.

user_id.description: User id whose mutual fund holdings should be fetched.

auth_session_id.description: Authenticated session id to use for fetching holdings via Kite MF APIs.

tool_schemas.name: get_mf_sips
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of mutual-fund SIP orders stored for the user, optionally filtered by local status, upstream_sip_id, tradingsymbol, frequency, tag, and created_at range, and sorted as requested; the response contains up to limit SIPs and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters (including bad enums, malformed timestamps, invalid cursor, or out-of-range limit) and UNAUTHORIZED when an auth_session_id is supplied but is invalid/expired or not owned by the user. Raises NOT_FOUND if user_id does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED for excessive read requests.

user_id.description: User id whose mutual fund SIPs should be returned.

auth_session_id.description: Authenticated session id to use for upstream access and to scope returned SIPs.

status.description: Filter SIPs by local lifecycle status.

upstream_sip_id.description: Filter by Zerodha upstream SIP id.

tag.description: Filter by optional client tag stored on the SIP.

created_after.description: Return SIPs created at or after this timestamp.

created_before.description: Return SIPs created at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of SIPs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: place_mf_sip
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new mutual-fund SIP for the given MF tradingsymbol by placing it with Zerodha using the authenticated session, and returns the created local SIP order record including its lifecycle status and the upstream SIP identifier when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, amounts are non-positive, instalments is < 6, frequency is invalid, or instalment_day is outside allowed bounds; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the session is invalid/expired or not owned by the user; raises NOT_FOUND if the tradingsymbol is unknown/inactive in the mirrored instrument set. Raises CONFLICT if the upstream rejects creation due to instrument restrictions (e.g., purchase not allowed) or an incompatible schedule, and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED/UPSTREAM_ERROR on Kite rate limits or failures.

user_id.description: User id placing the mutual fund SIP.

auth_session_id.description: Authenticated session id to use for placing the SIP via Kite MF APIs.

tradingsymbol.description: MF tradingsymbol to create the SIP for (e.g., INF090I01239).

initial_amount.description: Optional initial amount for the SIP.

instalment_day.description: Optional instalment day (1-31 for monthly, 1-7 for weekly).

tag.description: Optional client tag to attach to the SIP.

tool_schemas.name: modify_mf_sip
tool_schemas.description: Modifies an existing locally stored MF SIP (order_domain='mf_sip') by sending the requested changes to Zerodha (amount/frequency/instalments/instalment_day and/or status), and returns the updated local SIP record with refreshed lifecycle status and upstream response metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sip_id is malformed, no modifiable fields are provided, fields are out of range, or enums are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if sip_id does not exist or is not an MF SIP order. Raises CONFLICT if the SIP cannot be modified due to its current lifecycle state (e.g., cancelled/completed/rejected) or if the requested status transition (active↔paused) is not permitted, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED/UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream session is invalid, rate-limited, or fails.

sip_id.description: Local MF SIP order id to modify (orders.id for order_domain='mf_sip').

instalment_day.description: New day of the week/month on which the instalment should run (as provided to Zerodha).

tool_schemas.name: cancel_mf_sip
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an existing MF SIP (order_domain='mf_sip') with Zerodha and returns the updated local SIP order record with its final cancellation status and upstream response metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sip_id is malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the SIP does not exist or is not an MF SIP order. Raises CONFLICT if the SIP is already cancelled/completed/rejected or otherwise not cancellable, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED/UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream session is invalid, rate-limited, or cancellation fails.

sip_id.description: Local MF SIP order id to cancel (orders.id for order_domain='mf_sip').

tool_schemas.name: exchange_access_token
tool_schemas.description: Exchanges a captured request_token for a Kite access_token for the given auth session, transitioning the session to status='authenticated' on success and persisting token/expiry and Kite user identifiers. Refuses with CONFLICT if the auth session is not in 'request_token_received' (or has expired/revoked), VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed inputs, NOT_FOUND if the auth_session_id does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the referenced user/session.

auth_session_id.description: Auth session id to exchange a request_token for an access_token.

api_key.description: Zerodha Kite Connect api_key used for token exchange.

api_secret.description: Zerodha Kite Connect api_secret used for token exchange.

request_token.description: Request token received from Zerodha redirect; if omitted, the stored request_token for this session is used.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def exchange_access_token(auth_session_id, api_key, api_secret, request_token=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, secrets
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0125000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0125000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "exchange_access_token"

    def _now_dt():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

    def _iso(dt):
        if isinstance(dt, str):
            return dt
        if dt.tzinfo is None:
            dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(s, str):
            return None
        st = s.strip()
        try:
            if st.endswith("Z"):
                return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(st[:-1] + "+00:00")
            dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(st)
            return dt if dt.tzinfo else dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        except ValueError:
            return None

    def _audit(status, credential=None, err=None, meta=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        logs.append({
            "id": f"zui_req_{secrets.token_hex(8)}",
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "credential": credential,
            "status": status,
            "error_code": (err or {}).get("code") if isinstance(err, dict) else None,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "ts": _iso(_now_dt()),
            "meta": meta or {},
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    if not isinstance(auth_session_id, str) or not re.match(r"^zui_sess_[A-Za-z0-9]+$", auth_session_id):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "auth_session_id is malformed", field="auth_session_id")
        _audit("error", auth_session_id, e["error"])
        return e
    if not isinstance(api_key, str) or len(api_key) < 3:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "api_key must be a string with minLength 3", field="api_key")
        _audit("error", auth_session_id, e["error"])
        return e
    if not isinstance(api_secret, str) or len(api_secret) < 8:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "api_secret must be a string with minLength 8", field="api_secret")
        _audit("error", auth_session_id, e["error"])
        return e
    if request_token is not None and (not isinstance(request_token, str) or len(request_token) < 3):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "request_token must be a string with minLength 3", field="request_token")
        _audit("error", auth_session_id, e["error"])
        return e

    sessions = _load("auth_sessions.json")
    users = _load("users.json")
    if not isinstance(sessions, list): sessions = []
    if not isinstance(users, list): users = []

    sess = next((s for s in sessions if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("id") == auth_session_id), None)
    if sess is None:
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Auth session not found", auth_session_id=auth_session_id)
        _audit("error", auth_session_id, e["error"])
        return e

    user = next((u for u in users if isinstance(u, dict) and u.get("id") == sess.get("user_id")), None)
    if user is None or user.get("status") == "deleted":
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "User not found for auth session", user_id=sess.get("user_id"))
        _audit("error", auth_session_id, e["error"])
        return e
    if user.get("status") != "active":
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "User is not active", user_id=user.get("id"), user_status=user.get("status"))
        _audit("error", auth_session_id, e["error"])
        return e

    now = _now_dt()
    st = sess.get("status")

    # Idempotent: if already authenticated and token still valid, return session as-is.
    exp = _parse_dt(sess.get("access_token_expires_at"))
    if st == "authenticated" and sess.get("access_token") and exp is not None and exp > now:
        resp = dict(sess)
        _audit("ok", auth_session_id, meta={"idempotent": True})
        return resp

    # Allow exchange if request_token exists, even if status is authenticated (token refresh scenario) or request_token_received/login_initiated
    stored_rt = sess.get("request_token")
    rt_to_use = request_token if request_token is not None else stored_rt
    if not rt_to_use:
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "No request_token available to exchange for this session", auth_session_id=auth_session_id, status=st)
        _audit("error", auth_session_id, e["error"])
        return e

    # If session explicitly revoked, refuse
    if st == "revoked":
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "Auth session is revoked and cannot exchange tokens", auth_session_id=auth_session_id)
        _audit("error", auth_session_id, e["error"])
        return e

    # If request_token has expired, refuse
    rte = _parse_dt(sess.get("request_token_expires_at"))
    if rte is not None and rte <= now:
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "Stored request_token has expired; re-initiate login", auth_session_id=auth_session_id, request_token_expires_at=sess.get("request_token_expires_at"))
        _audit("error", auth_session_id, e["error"])
        return e

    # Perform "exchange": generate deterministic-ish access token (offline) and set EOD expiry
    access_token = f"acc_{secrets.token_urlsafe(24)}"
    eod = now.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(hour=23, minute=59, second=0, microsecond=0)

    # Enforce lifecycle transition to authenticated if legal; otherwise still allow update (service may store authenticated regardless)
    transitions = {
        "created": ["login_initiated", "failed"],
        "login_initiated": ["request_token_received", "failed", "expired"],
        "request_token_received": ["authenticated", "failed", "expired"],
        "authenticated": ["expired", "revoked", "failed"],
        "expired": ["login_initiated"],
        "revoked": ["login_initiated"],
        "failed": ["login_initiated"],
    }
    if st not in transitions:
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "Auth session has invalid status", auth_session_id=auth_session_id, status=st)
        _audit("error", auth_session_id, e["error"])
        return e

    # If status isn't allowed to go to authenticated, refuse (except already authenticated handled above)
    if st != "authenticated" and "authenticated" not in transitions.get(st, []):
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "Auth session is not ready for token exchange", auth_session_id=auth_session_id, status=st)
        _audit("error", auth_session_id, e["error"])
        return e

    sess["access_token"] = access_token
    sess["access_token_expires_at"] = _iso(eod)
    sess["kite_user_id"] = sess.get("kite_user_id") or user.get("zerodha_client_id")
    sess["status"] = "authenticated"
    sess["last_error_code"] = None
    sess["last_error_message"] = None
    sess["updated_at"] = _iso(now)

    # Keep request_token stored (some clients read it later); do not force-clear.
    if sess.get("request_token") is None:
        sess["request_token"] = rt_to_use

    _save("auth_sessions.json", sessions)
    _audit("ok", auth_session_id, meta={"authenticated": True, "access_token_expires_at": sess.get("access_token_expires_at")})
    return dict(sess)

tool_schemas.name: list_orders
tool_schemas.description: Lists locally persisted orders for the given user with optional filtering by domain and lifecycle status, returning results in reverse chronological order. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters, NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the user.

user_id.description: User id whose orders should be listed.

order_domain.description: Restrict results to a specific order domain.

status.description: Restrict results to a specific local lifecycle status.

upstream_order_id.description: Filter by Zerodha upstream order id (for Kite/MF orders).

upstream_sip_id.description: Filter by Zerodha upstream SIP id (for MF SIPs).

created_after.description: Return orders created at or after this timestamp.

created_before.description: Return orders created at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list_orders response.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_order
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an existing Kite order that was placed via place_order, sending the cancel request upstream and persisting the result by transitioning the local order status to 'cancelled' when upstream confirms. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the order_id does not exist, CONFLICT if the order is not cancellable (e.g., already completed/cancelled/rejected), VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed inputs, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the order/user/session.

user_id.description: User id that owns the order.

auth_session_id.description: Authenticated session to use for cancelling the order on Kite.

tool_schemas.name: update_user_status
tool_schemas.description: Updates a user's lifecycle status according to allowed transitions (active↔suspended, active/suspended→deleted). Returns the updated user record. Refuses with CONFLICT if the transition is not allowed (e.g., deleted→*), NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed inputs, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot update the user.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the user.

tool_schemas.name: get_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption for this API key/token. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the provided credential is missing, invalid, or expired.

include_quota.description: When true, include rate-limit/quota consumption and reset timestamps if available.

metadata.name: Zerodha Integration
metadata.description: This backend stores Zerodha (Kite) authentication sessions and the user’s trading and mutual-fund activity mirrored from Zerodha for API access. Core workflows are: initiate login → capture request_token → exchange for access_token (authenticated session), then fetch portfolio/positions/margins/quot
